comparison.objective: Collect an anterior nasal specimen and return the swab to its tube.
comparison.physical_skill: Perform depth- and force-controlled circular motion with a slender swab.
comparison.success_condition: Four valid circles per nostril, uncontaminated capped swab, safe forces, and stable release.
comparison.reason: Compliant-contact swabbing and contamination avoidance are materially different from manipulating a screen to separate rigid media.
